scripts.lint: npm run lint-root-config && npm run lint-eslint-plugins && npm run lint-markdown-outside-workspaces && npm run lint-markdown-style && npm run lint-html-outside-workspaces && npm run lint-json-outside-workspaces && npm --workspaces --if-present run lint
scripts.lint-with-fix: npm run lint-root-config -- --fix && npm run lint-eslint-plugins -- --fix && npm run lint-markdown-outside-workspaces -- --fix && npm run lint-markdown-style -- --fix && npm run lint-html-outside-workspaces -- --fix && npm run lint-json-outside-workspaces -- --fix && npm --workspaces --if-present run lint-with-fix
